market_summary: US 13:30 UTC economic data triggered widespread volatility expansion across all assets during the London/NY overlap. Gold and Silver staged classic liquidity sweeps above dynamic resistance (VWAP, EMA50, and upper ATR envelopes) before suffering violent high-volume rejections confirmed by bearish CVD and RVOL > 2.0 yellow spikes, offering clean short setups. Meanwhile, EURUSD compressed back to POC/VWAP, US100 and GBPUSD left prominent upper exhaustion wicks near session highs, and BTCUSD showed bearish CVD divergence at its Value Area High, dictating selective SELL execution on precious metals and HOLD across FX, crypto, and equities.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3908.89) and trading below POC (3895.22). CVD is -5.16 with a BEARISH label and negative slope (-1.68), which agrees with the bearish sell momentum. Trading in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP with no automation block. Price is firmly below VWAP (3899.35), which capped the news-driven spike, and remains below EMA50 (3895.80) confirming structural trend weakness. The signal bar spiked to test the upper ATR band (3906.90, reaching 3905.66) before violently rejecting back to the mid-channel. Volume is heavily confirmed with RVOL at 2.803 (yellow spike bar). The move represents a classic liquidity sweep above EMA50 and POC, failing and rejecting back below S/R 3887.45 with clear room to target VAL 3884.20 and Session Low 3878.91. GEX is null.
